scope: Real published Rust SDK and real SiliconFlow requests; synthetic prompts and isolated application data. Multiple scenarios partially overlap; latency comparisons are descriptive, not controlled model rankings. No provider responses replaced. No paid/other-free-model fallback.

cross_process.clock_note: Each relative trace is aligned using its wall_clock_started timestamp, recorded just after Trace initialization; overlap is seconds long, not a sub-millisecond ordering claim.
